During the course of hearing on 17.1.2023, representative of the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner has already served the copy of the Petitions on the BPC and CTUIL and has complied with all the requirements under the Transmission Licence Regulations including publishing of notice on its website inviting suggestions/objections on its application for grant of transmission licence. However, no suggestion /objection has been received. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **4** of **17** 7. The Petitioner has served copy of the Respondents. However, no reply has been filed by them. CTUIL has filed the information called for. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **6** of **17** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **7** of **17** 14. The Petitioner has furnished the Contract Performance Guarantee (CPG) in favour of Nodal Agency i.e., CTUIL for an aggregate value of Rs. 9 crore on 18.11.2022 and has acquired hundred percent equity holding in Gadag II-A ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **8** of **17** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **9** of **17** _(6) Immediately on making the application, the applicant shall forward a copy of the application to the Central Transmission Utility._ ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **10** of **17** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **11** of **17** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **12** of **17** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **13** of **17** _vii) Hon'ble Commission has also granted Regulatory Approval for the transmission scheme vide order dated 26.11.2021 in Petition No. 200/MP/2019._ 22. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner, BPC and CTUIL. The proviso to Clause 2.15.2 of the RfP provides that "if for any reason attributable to the BPC, the said activities are not completed by the Selected Bidder within the above period of ten (10) days as mentioned in this clause, such period of 10 days shall be extended, on a day to day basis till the end of the Bid validity period". As per the above provision, selected bidder was required to complete all the activities including acquisition of SPVs by 7.9.2022. Though LoI was issued on 19.9.2022, BPC, vide its letter dated 21.11.2022, in terms of Clauses 2.15.2 of RfP extended the date upto ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **14** of **17** 24. It is expected that while carrying out the survey, the Petitioner has complied with the provisions of clause 2.5.7.3, clause 2.5.7.4 and clause 2.5.7.5 of the RfP. The Petitioner will comply with the provisions of bidding documents and TSA for commissioning of the Project within the SCOD. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **15** of **17** 25. In order to ensure that the Project is implemented within the time schedule as provided in the TSA, the licensee should not approach the Commission for extension of time for execution of the Project or for increase in the transmission charges over and above what is permissible under the provisions of the TSA. Accordingly, the Petitioner is directed to file an affidavit by 15.2.2023 to the effect that the execution of the Project shall not be delayed due to time taken in obtaining statutory clearances required under the RfP and/ or adjudication of any claim of the Petitioner arising under the TSA. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Order in Petition No. 351/TL/2022 **16** of **17**
